actions.excerpt:
kubectl create secret generic hf-token `
  --from-file=token="$env:TEMP\hf-token.txt" `
  -n <namespace> `
  --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
actions.reason: Applies a generated Kubernetes Secret named hf-token from a local token file; namespace is a placeholder and this is documented example code.
Removes the temporary token file at $env:TEMP\hf-token.txt after secret creation; the path is environment-dependent.
